settings.name: USE_BAD_BEHAVIOR
settings.description: **Enable Bad Behavior:** Set to `yes` to enable the bad behavior detection and banning feature.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_STATUS_CODES
settings.description: **Bad Status Codes:** List of HTTP status codes that will be counted as "bad" behavior when returned to a client.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_THRESHOLD
settings.description: **Threshold:** The number of "bad" status codes an IP can generate within the counting period before being banned.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_COUNT_TIME
settings.description: **Count Period:** The time window (in seconds) during which bad status codes are counted toward the threshold. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_BAN_TIME
settings.description: **Ban Duration:** How long (in seconds) an IP will remain banned after exceeding the threshold. Default is 24 hours (86400 seconds). Set to `0` for permanent bans that never expire. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_BAN_SCOPE
settings.description: **Ban Scope:** Determines whether bans apply only to the current service (`service`) or to all services (`global`). Bans triggered on the default server (`_`) are always global.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_REPORT_MAX_EVENTS
settings.description: Maximum recent events kept as ban evidence in reports, also limited by `BAD_BEHAVIOR_THRESHOLD`. Range: `1` to `10000`.

settings.name: BAD_BEHAVIOR_REPORT_MAX_STRING_SIZE
settings.description: Maximum bytes per URL or method in report evidence, including the `...` marker. Range: `4` to `65536`.
